blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — A total of 110 newly hatched hawksbill sea turtles were released into the sea off Barangay Agpanabat in Romblon town, Romblon province, on Nov. 10, as part of efforts to protect endangered marine wildlife. The Coast Guard Station (CGS) Romblon joined the Pawikan Association, local government officials and other government agencies in the conservation activity to ensure the hatchlings’ safe return to their natural marine habitat. READ: 95 baby hawksbill sea turtles released in Albay The hatchlings belong to the hawksbill turtle species (Eretmochelys imbricata), which is classified as critically endangered.
